name: TimeClockEntry
description: An employee shift clock-in and clock-out record.

deleted.description: Whether the entry is marked as deleted.

payRateAmount.description: Hourly pay rate in US dollars, as a decimal string.

declaredCashTipsAmount.description: Declared cash tips collected, as a decimal string.

declaredCashTipsToOthersAmount.description: Declared cash tips given to others, as a decimal string.

outAt.description: RFC 3339 shift end (clock-out) time. May be null if the shift is open.

breaks.description: Break records taken during the shift.

items.description: A break taken during a time clock shift.

startedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the break started.

endedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the break ended. May be null if the break is ongoing.

kind.description: Whether the break is paid or unpaid.

lastUpdatedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last update.
